note: Static descriptors for the DuckDB warehouse views (db.py) and the SQLite state tables (state/schema.sql). Seeds are NOT listed here — services/catalog.py auto-discovers them via seeds.names()+seeds.meta(); parameters are discovered via parameters.list_params(). Warehouse views are read-only parquet (provenance: real); SQLite tables are mutable demo state (provenance: real — the records are produced by governed in-app actions).

warehouse.name: entity_roles
warehouse.description: One row per legal entity: country (LAND1), TP role code/description, arm's-length operating-margin band (OM_LOW_PCT/OM_HIGH_PCT), and the role boolean flags (IS_PRINCIPAL, IS_IP_OWNER, IS_FINANCING_ARM, IS_LRD, …).
warehouse.lineage: Consumed by /api/entities, /api/kpis, services/entities.py; drives the entity directory + role overlay across the cockpit.

warehouse.name: segment_pl
warehouse.description: Segmented P&L per entity/segment/period (GJAHR/POPER): revenue, cogs, opex_production/rd/sm/ga/dist, ic_charges, depreciation, operating_profit, operating_margin. The arm's-length-margin and allocation base for most calcs.
warehouse.lineage: Consumed by /api/csa, /api/profit-split, /api/beat, /api/stewardship, /api/forecast, /api/segments/pl, pnl.py; the single GROUP-BY source the calc engine aggregates.

warehouse.name: supply_chain
warehouse.description: Planned intercompany legal-price book by chain step: material/type, IP owner, selling/buying company, TP method, volume, standard cost, markup rate, TOTAL_LEGAL_PRICE, APA/CHALLENGED flags, AWREF (the posting key back to journal).
warehouse.lineage: Consumed by /api/reconciliation (planned price), /api/wht, /api/vat, /api/transactions/* (flows/pricing); the price-vs-posted reconciliation anchor.

warehouse.name: journal
warehouse.description: ACDOCA-shaped universal journal: posted documents (RBUKRS/GJAHR/BELNR/DOCLN), account (RACCT), related party (RASSC), amounts in document/local/group currency (TSL/KSL/HSL), reversal/settlement lineage. The posted-actuals side.
warehouse.lineage: Consumed by /api/journal-entries, /api/reconciliation (posted HSL), /api/beat (RASSC base), /api/invoices; ties posted flows back to plan.

state.name: audit_events
state.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit stream — one row per state change anywhere in the platform. Written only through state/audit.py:record().
state.lineage: Written by every governed action; read by /api/audit, /api/audit/verify, /api/evidence/{ref}.

state.name: process_drafts
state.lineage: Read/written by /api/drafts; surfaced in the unified inbox (/api/worklist).

state.name: users
state.description: Demo users and their single role (operator|reviewer|director); active user via X-OTP-User header.
state.lineage: Seeded from seeds/users; drives separation-of-duties in the review queue.

state.name: review_items
state.description: Maker-checker review queue — pending|approved|rejected items per record_ref.

state.name: adjustments
state.description: Submitted true-up / period-end adjustment records (full JSON in data + promoted status).

state.name: policy_overrides
state.description: Editable per-flow policy overrides applied over the warehouse price book.

state.name: seed_versions
state.description: Tracks which seed file versions have been loaded (version-gated reseed).
state.lineage: Maintained by the seed loaders (state/master_data.py, cases.py, parameters.py).

state.name: md_entity_function
state.description: Editable TP function overlay per entity (function code, primary/tested-party flags, categories).

state.name: md_overlay
state.description: Per-context master-data overlay (policy/ICA/APA refs, target override, notes).

state.name: md_mapping
state.description: Applied canonical master-data mappings (raw key → canonical JSON).

state.name: cases
state.description: Governance cases (Case Workspace — OTP-30/31/40/50): controversy/restructuring/integration matters with status, owner, due date, checklist + audit trail.
state.lineage: Read/written by /api/cases; aggregated into /api/worklist; linked from documentation processes.

state.name: parameters
state.description: Governed parameter store — one row per calc parameter pulled out of router code into a single auditable registry (value/default JSON-encoded). Every edit hash-chained at param:{key}.
state.lineage: Read by csa.py/beat.py/reconciliation.py via get_param; read/written by /api/parameters; entries also surfaced as catalog 'parameter' kind.
